description: This file implements the ExponentialDistribution class as part of the Apache Commons Math library, providing methods for probability density, cumulative distribution, inverse cumulative, and sampling from the distribution, along with relevant parameters and constructors.

classes.name: ExponentialDistribution
classes.description: A class representing the exponential distribution, providing probability density functions, distribution functions, inverse functions, and sampling methods.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function at a given point.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cumulative distribution function (quantile function) for a given probability.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the exponential distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (always positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the lower support bound is inclusive (true).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the upper support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates if the support of the distribution is connected (true).
